description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_Session, which manages session storage for user agent data within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for constructing session storage, checking if storage is empty, reading, writing, and clearing session data, and handles session namespace and member configuration.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_Session
classes.description: A class that manages session storage for user agent data, encapsulating session namespace and member handling, with methods for storage operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes session storage with optional configuration, setting namespace and member, and creating a Zend_Session_Namespace object.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Returns the session object member name.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the session storage is empty.
